title: typo3-structured-data: the skill at work
description: One JSON-LD graph from the records that render the page. Recorded on a TYPO3 14.3 site in DDEV and in the Schema.org Validator. Narrated, with English captions.
alt: Film, 48 seconds: the typo3-structured-data agent skill. It keeps an upgrade identical, then checks one JSON-LD graph per page against the visible page on seven TYPO3 14 pages. The Schema.org Validator reports no errors. Narrated, with English captions.

transcript.text: AI answers need markup that matches the page. Many sites keep a hidden second truth.
You ask for markup before the upgrade baseline.
The skill keeps the upgrade identical, adds the graph afterwards, and checks every page.
The validator finds no errors. The graph says what the page shows.
No invented facts. Valid markup earns eligibility, not a promise.
